from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545741/attempts/24c6b32aa5ef47bea0ad877ddcf721da/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Solid full-width/full-height lines split the canvas into panels.
    row_cuts = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    col_cuts = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    def spans(n, cuts):
        out=[]; start=0
        for i in cuts:
            if start < i: out.append((start, i))
            start=i+1
        if start<n: out.append((start,n))
        return out
    rs, cs = spans(h,row_cuts), spans(w,col_cuts)
    panels=[]
    for r0,r1 in rs:
        for c0,c1 in cs:
            vals=[grid[r][c] for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)]
            panels.append((r0,r1,c0,c1,vals))
    # The panel containing the drawn pattern has the greatest diversity.
    src=max(panels,key=lambda p:(len(set(p[4])),sum(v != max(set(p[4]),key=p[4].count) for v in p[4])))
    r0,r1,c0,c1,_=src
    pattern=[row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for a,b,x,y,_ in panels:
        if (a,b,x,y)==(r0,r1,c0,c1) or (b-a,x-y)!=(r1-r0,c1-c0):
            continue
        for i in range(b-a): out[a+i][x:y]=pattern[i][:]
    return out
'''

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    background=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_cuts=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r]))==1 and grid[r][0]!=background]
    col_cuts=[c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and grid[0][c]!=background]
    def spans(n,cuts):
        out=[]; start=0
        for i in cuts:
            if start<i: out.append((start,i))
            start=i+1
        if start<n: out.append((start,n))
        return out
    rs,cs=spans(h,row_cuts),spans(w,col_cuts)
    panels=[]
    for a,b in rs:
        for x,y in cs:
            vals=[grid[r][c] for r in range(a,b) for c in range(x,y)]
            panels.append((a,b,x,y,vals))
    src=max(panels,key=lambda p:(len(set(p[4])),sum(v!=background for v in p[4])))
    a,b,x,y,_=src
    pattern=[row[x:y] for row in grid[a:b]]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0,r1,c0,c1,_ in panels:
        if (r0,r1,c0,c1)==(a,b,x,y) or (r1-r0,c1-c0)!=(b-a,y-x): continue
        for i in range(b-a): out[r0+i][c0:c1]=pattern[i][:]
    return out
'''
